verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer recurring or automatic filings such as scheduled annual-list renewals, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no automation or scheduling capability. The probes only show bot walls at robots.txt on www.nvsos.gov and the esos/orion filing portal, which concern agent access rather than user-configurable background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
